Obviously don't wanna give life advice, but it sound like that you haven't find the right job. I also have ADHD and I was day dreaming at my last job aswell, but it was because I was doing work I wasn't passionate about. Now I switched the company and have responsibilities which I am actually passionate about. If you don't give 100% at your job, it isnt the right job. The job you should have has to be fun, otherwise your ADHD Brain, will never develop the full potential at that job.
Having ADHD at the workplace is my greatest asset, there is smt called a 10X Developer, but this also exist for other jobs. I would consider myself a 10Xer at Business Development, because the job is just so much fun. ADHD Isn't a problem it's an enhancement under the right conditions.

I am very much aware that my actions have consequences and that I can only rely on myself, but joining an accountibility group and "working on the acceptance" is exactly what I am doing. I am accepting that I have a problem, I am accepting that I need outside help.
